$comment: SPEC v0.4.8 row 2: the resolved payload of a directive that puts an item on the View
(view.take, the control plane's cut, snapshot.recall). Read by BOTH readers:
nbe-protocol's mirror (TakePayload, which the engine reads) and the control plane's
protocol.test.ts (TakeDirectivePayloadSchema, which the control plane parses its own
payloads through before sending). `valid` must read on both sides and round-trip in Rust;
`invalid` must be refused by both. durationFrames is the TRANSITION's length;
itemDurationFrames is the ITEM's own duration. The two are never the same field.

valid.name: a cut to an untimed item
a cut to a timed item
a mix to a timed item: both durations, and they differ
a recall of a timed item, overlays wholesale
a recall of an empty View

invalid.name: an item duration that is not a number
a transition length that is not a number
overlays that are not a list
